issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (see lines that state the method must be static), but the solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (non-static) in SealSaloon. This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students about whether the method should be static and may cause tests or student implementations to diverge from the intended design.
issues.suggestedFix: Make calculateTotalPrice a static method in SealSaloon to match the problem statement (e.g., public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) {...}), or alternatively update the problem statement to remove or change the requirement that calculateTotalPrice must be static so it matches the solution. Ensure tests and any example code are aligned with the chosen approach.
